title.narrative: Gender at the Center Initiative (GCI)

description.narrative: GCI will build on the gender-responsive education sector planning (GRESP) approach championed by the United Nations Girls Education Initiative (UNGEI) and with the technical support of UNESCO, UNICEF, GPE and civil society organizations. GCI will support: a) the ministries of education in eight countries (Burkina Faso, Chad, Mali, Mauritania, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, and Sierra Leone) to take the lead in identifying and addressing key barriers specific to their context by providing them with a demand-drive package of facilitation, training, technical assistance, and advice; and b) the strengthening of the education enabling environment, including partnering with civil society organizations (CSO), at country, regional and global levels.

title.narrative: Intermediate outcome 1: Improved gender equality mainstreaming in and through education led and implemented by Ministry of Education in conjunction with other relevant Ministries

description.narrative: Refers to GE mainstreaming in education structures, policies, plans, strategies, practices, norms, standards, budgets, and programs, reflecting MoE capacitiesand commitment in this regard

title.narrative: Degree of internal coherence and integration of MoEs GE activities within the broader education sector

description.narrative: The degree of coherence among interventions led and/or implemented by MoEs to address barriers to GE in education was assessed based on five criteria: (1) There is a pooled fund or SWAP which includes specific provisions to address gender barriers to education; (2) There is a dedicated and functional coordination mechanism in the education sector addressing gender barriers in education (e.g., Gender Working Group of LEG); (3) There is evidence of alignment between ESP gender objectives and the interventions of key education sector actors; (4) There is evidence of complementarity, synergy, collaboration among education sector actors to implement joint and/or coordinated initiatives with regard to addressing gender barriers to education; (5) There is evidence of joint monitoring and evaluation of ESP objectives, strategies, action plans and initiatives related to addressing gender barriers to education. The rating scale is defined as follows: Highly coherent all 5 criteria met; Coherent 34 criteria met; Somewhat coherent 12 criteria met; Not coherent None of the criteria met.
